articles.title_en: Romania closes Russia’s consulate general in Constanta after Russian drone crashes on residential building
articles.lead_en: Romania is expelling Consul General Andrei Kosilin and closing Russia’s consulate general in Constanta. Romanian President Nicusor Dan announced the decision after a meeting of the country’s Supreme Defense Council, convened following the crash of a Russian drone on the roof of a residential building in the city of Galati.
